recipeName: Chicken Tikka Masala with Coconut Cream

ingredients.original: 1 1/2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
ingredients.adapted: 2¼ lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
1 cup plus 2 tablespoons plain unsweetened dairy-free coconut yogurt
ingredients.changeReason: Coconut yogurt provides an acidic, coating marinade without dairy; choose an unsweetened, unflavored variety.
Vegan butter supplies the fat needed to soften the onion and bloom the spices without dairy.
Rounded to whole onions; the extra onion gives the sauce a slightly sweeter base.

ingredients.original: 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, plus more to taste
ingredients.adapted: ¾ teaspoon kosher salt, plus more to taste

ingredients.changeReason: Coconut cream restores the sauce's richness without dairy; unsweetened soy cooking cream offers a less coconut-forward alternative.

alternative.adapted: 3/4 cup unsweetened dairy-free soy cooking cream
alternative.tradeoff: Soy cooking cream tastes more neutral, while coconut cream gives a richer body.
alternative.stepNote: Keep the sauce at a gentle simmer rather than a hard boil after adding soy cooking cream.

steps.title: Marinate the Chicken
steps.instruction: Stir the dairy-free coconut yogurt, lemon juice, the marinade portion of garam masala and the marinade portion of salt together in a bowl, then add the chicken, turn to coat every piece and leave to marinate at room temperature for 20 minutes while you make the sauce.
ingredients_used: 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons plain unsweetened dairy-free coconut yogurt
2¼ lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
steps.updated_note: Stir the coconut yogurt smooth before coating the chicken; a thick, cultured variety clings better than a thin yogurt.

steps.title: Soften the Onion
steps.instruction: Melt the vegan butter in a wide, deep skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat, then add the onion and the sauce portion of salt and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 to 14 minutes, until soft and golden at the edges.
ingredients_used: ¾ teaspoon kosher salt, plus more to taste
steps.updated_note: Use a wide vessel with room for the larger batch; the extra onion may need a few more minutes to release its moisture and turn golden.

steps.title: Toast the Spices
steps.instruction: Add the garlic and ginger and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Stir in the remaining garam masala, the cumin, paprika and turmeric and cook for 30 seconds more, stirring constantly so the spices toast without scorching.

steps.title: Reduce the Tomato Sauce
steps.instruction: Pour in the crushed tomatoes and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan, then bring to a gentle simmer, lower the heat and cook uncovered for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce thickens enough to leave a trail when you drag a spoon through it.
steps.updated_note: Start checking at 10 minutes; a wider pan evaporates liquid faster, so use the spoon trail rather than multiplying the original cooking time.

steps.title: Broil the Marinated Chicken
steps.instruction: While the sauce simmers, heat the broiler with a rack about 6 inches below the element, then lift the chicken from the marinade, letting the excess drip off, spread in a single uncrowded layer on two foil-lined baking sheets and discard the leftover marinade; broil one sheet at a time for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until charred in spots, then promptly transfer each batch to the simmering sauce to finish cooking. Cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F (74°C) internally.
ingredients_used: 2¼ lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
1 cup plus 2 tablespoons plain unsweetened dairy-free coconut yogurt
steps.updated_note: Allow two broiler batches at this size, keeping the cooking time per batch unchanged; let excess coconut yogurt drip off so the coating chars rather than pools.

steps.title: Finish the Creamy Sauce
steps.instruction: Stir the coconut cream into the sauce with the chicken and any juices from the baking sheets, then simmer gently for about 5 minutes after the last batch is added, until the chicken is cooked through and an instant-read thermometer in the thickest pieces reads 165°F (74°C).
ingredients_used: 2¼ lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
steps.updated_note: Whisk separated coconut cream smooth before adding and keep the sauce at a gentle simmer; check several chicken pieces rather than extending cooking time in proportion to the batch size.

steps.title: Season and Serve
steps.instruction: Taste and add more salt if needed. If the sauce is thicker than you like, loosen it with a splash of water. Serve over the rice, scattered with the cilantro.
ingredients_used: ¾ teaspoon kosher salt, plus more to taste

explanations: Coconut yogurt and coconut cream keep the marinade tangy and the sauce rich, though the finished dish will have a gentle coconut flavor rather than dairy's more neutral richness.
Choose plain unsweetened coconut cream, not sweetened cream of coconut, and check that the vegan butter contains no milk derivatives.
The larger batch needs more broiler space, not longer broiling per piece; keeping the chicken uncrowded preserves the char that balances the creamy sauce.
refine_suggestion: e.g. swap chicken thighs for chicken breast
yieldText: 1 plate with 1 cup rice and chicken sauce each
